pages.title: Photonic Neuron
pages.text: A neuron that computes with light instead of ions. Quantum dots act as its synapses, Cherenkov quartz carries the signal, and superfluid helium keeps the noise down. It thinks at the speed of light and flickers faintly whenever something new crosses its path.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Neural Synthesizer, I arranged quantum dots so their emission depended on the light reaching them, and joined them with quartz waveguides. One dot started firing only when two others did: the first logic of a photonic brain.
